We need qualifiers for dates: announced on September 9, 2014; released on September 19, 2014; replaced on September 9, 2015.

Also "successor to" relation: iPhone 6 successor of iPhone 5S. Actually "successors to the iPhone 5S". So iPhone 6 and iPhone 6 Plus are successors of iPhone 5S. So relation "successor of". Could also have "replaced by" relation: iPhone 6 replaced by iPhone 6S.

Also "designed and marketed by Apple Inc." Could split into two relations: "designed by" and "marketed by". Or combine as "designed and marketed by". Probably separate.

Also "part of iPhone series". Relation "part of". Could also "belongs to product line".
